i could see this making more sense for allowing the option to turn your home world into a friends only world without making a new instance of your home world. Allow only those users who know you from your friends list to join. However, I'd probably hold on the friends+ function only because, despite the fact that your friend is with you, you may or may not know who their friend(s) is.
Say that you want to have your friend join your home world and you either just wanna chill and watch movies/YouTube videos on your home's video player (depending on what your home world is). But then one of their friends joins off them, and let's say that they're some person that likes to annoy others (cause there can be some friends that are like that). Keep in mind that this is your friend's friend. While yes you can kick that person out of your home world depending on if they're being annoying/intrusive, it's an unnecessary step for you to take and is about a minute of your time taken.
While I'm not saying that a friends+ home world isn't possible, it's simply that I would rather want it to be a home world where I can allow anyone of my online friends, who I'm most familiar with, to join without having to send an invite request all the time.
Hope they finally add This. I lost This Feature when they Blocked mods... Was so nice with f+ as home world.
Wow it took 4 years and alienating a big portion of the userbase to implement this.

details:
Currently, you load into an invite-only instance of your selected home world when you launch the game. I'd vastly prefer for it to be friends+, so I could hang around there and let people join me as and when they please.
I believe this would also help somewhat in situations where a user gets on to see their friends and finds all of them are in invite instances, where the common choices would usually be to either exit the game or request invites with no guarantee of hearing back.
title: Allow setting your home world to a friends/friends+ instance.
